project.researchNotes: Sequential place 14 of 14. Strict settlement merit, See, café-led Eat, all named trail providers, picnic, public visitor parking, public toilets, access, transport, dogs and complete local HES/NRHE construction dates were checked before continuing. The former railway context is not a presented visitor attraction. Carnbee, Dunino and Crail facilities are not transferred.
